purpose: Sanitized, append-only meaningful work iterations; raw deployment evidence remains ignored.

entries.objective: Validate the scoped OCI release using broker instance principals
observed_facts: One E5 worker acquired and reached the expected running state; return and termination were confirmed.
No user OCI profile was present on the broker; this was genuine broker-principal validation.
The original parent compartment was used. A retained historical IAM snapshot has four broad statements, but is not a timestamped policy audit of this run.
The preceding failure was followed by the signed launch retry-token fix and this successful run.
entries.next_action: Preserve this exact last-good checkpoint when comparing later deployments.
limits: Historical acceptance does not prove the current source, policy and child-compartment setup.

observed_facts: An equivalent stock-Ubuntu E5 launch using operator credentials reached RUNNING.
The worker and boot volume were removed afterward.
The inherited Security Zone has one enabled load-balancer SSL rule, unrelated to this Compute launch.

hypotheses: The paired result points toward broker-principal access, but does not identify a specific missing permission.
